faq.title: Good to know
faq.q1: How long does delivery take in Chhattisgarh?
faq.a1: Most orders arrive in 1–3 days. The product page shows the expected time and your order page shows each step.
faq.a2: Pay online with UPI, cards or net banking through Razorpay, or pay cash on delivery where it is offered at checkout.
faq.q3: What if the part does not fit?
faq.a3: Tell us within 7 days from your order page. After a quick check we replace it or refund you. Opened lubricants and installed batteries cannot be returned.
faq.a4: Our team calls or visits every workshop, checks its location and services, and watches its reviews.
faq.q5: Will a workshop start work without asking me?
faq.a5: No. You approve the itemised estimate line by line before any work starts.
faq.q6: Can I order in bulk for my garage or fleet?
faq.a6: Yes. Ask for a bulk price from any product page or your cart and agree the final price with our team in a chat.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lead: What we keep about you, why, who sees it, and how you stay in control. Plain words, no surprises.
privacy.whoBody: MechDost is run by {company}, {address}. We decide how your data is used and we answer for it.
privacy.collectBody: Your name, mobile number and email; a password, stored only as a scrambled code we cannot read back; delivery addresses; your vehicles and service history; your orders, bookings and support messages.
privacy.purposeBody: To deliver your orders and run your workshop bookings, to answer your support requests, to keep accounts safe from misuse, and to keep the order and tax records the law asks for. Nothing else without asking you first.
privacy.shareBody: Only the shop or workshop handling your order or booking, and only after they accept it — your number and address stay hidden until then. Order updates on WhatsApp go through Meta when you have them switched on. We never sell your data.
privacy.photosBody: The workshop photographs your vehicle when it arrives and when the work is done. You and the workshop can see these photos on your request; our staff see them to help with a complaint. Location details in the photo are removed. If MechDost turns it on, photos of completed jobs may also be shown on the workshop’s page, so we advise the workshop not to include number plates or people.
privacy.analyticsTitle: Analytics, only if you allow it
privacy.analyticsBody: With “Allow analytics” we count page visits and clicks to improve MechDost. Our servers pass these counts to our analytics provider PostHog, on its servers in the European Union, under a random visitor number. They never hold your name, number or address, phone numbers or emails typed into search are removed first, and nothing goes to PostHog without your permission. Choose “Essential only” any time with “Privacy choices” at the bottom of every page.
privacy.errorsBody: When a page or our servers fail, a short technical report goes to Sentry, our error-tracking provider, on its servers in the European Union, so we can fix the fault. Reports hold the page address and what went wrong, never your name, number, address or anything you typed; we need them to keep the site working, so they are sent without asking.
privacy.safeBody: Encrypted connections everywhere, sensitive details encrypted again in our database, staff access only for the part of their job, and a log of every change staff make.
privacy.rightsBody: Ask us to show, correct or delete your data, or withdraw a permission you gave. Deletion is confirmed by our support team first; order and invoice records are kept as long as tax law requires, then removed.
privacy.help: Questions, requests or complaints about your data? Call us:
privacy.ustaadBody: The Ustaad Network is a part of MechDost only for people who repair vehicles. If you join, we keep your network profile: your name, area, the work you do, years of experience, level and Izzat, and your garage name only if you choose to show it. You can post voice notes, photos, short videos, PDF documents, links, polls and text, and ask and answer questions. Your phone number is never shown to other members.
privacy.ustaadAudienceBody: Only signed-in members of the network, who are mechanics, see your profile and posts. Customers and the public do not, and network pages are kept out of search engines. A post you share on WhatsApp shows only a card asking people to sign in, never the post itself. Our community managers see network content to keep it safe. Photos lose their location and camera details when uploaded, and the tool to blur faces and number plates is on by default.
privacy.ustaadLocationBody: By default other mechanics see only your area name and a rough circle, never your exact spot. In nearby lists they see a distance band such as under 2 km, never the exact distance. Your exact pin is shown only if you switch on Show my exact pin, and only to the people you pick. If you work from home or on the road, only your area name is shown. Area totals appear only when enough mechanics are counted that nobody can be picked out.
privacy.ustaadCorrectionTitle: Smart correction of what you type
privacy.ustaadCorrectionBody: When smart correction is on, the text you type may be sent to an AI service that fixes spelling, which may process it outside India. Before it is sent, phone numbers, vehicle number plates, emails, PIN codes and member names are replaced by placeholders, and your name and member number are never sent. Voice notes are never sent anywhere and are never turned into text. You keep your original text, and you can turn smart correction off in Settings and my choices. Your text is not used to train our systems unless you agree to that separately.
privacy.ustaadModerationBody: Any member can report a post, comment, profile, job or message. Our community managers check reports, may hold or remove content, and may warn, restrict or ban an account. You are told why, in your language, and you can appeal through MechDost support, where a different staff member decides. Some new posts with photos or videos are checked before they appear. Messages are private: staff read a message only when it has been reported, and each such reading is recorded.
privacy.ustaadRetentionTitle: How long network data is kept
privacy.ustaadRetentionBody: Stories disappear after 24 hours and their files are deleted soon after. Removed content is kept out of sight for 180 days for complaints and the law, then deleted, unless the law requires us to keep it longer. Proof given for verification, such as a signboard photo or the garage owner's contact, is deleted 30 days after the decision; only the result and the date stay. If you leave the network your profile is hidden and you keep your MechDost account. To delete your data, ask us as described under Your choices and rights.
privacy.ustaadConsentsBody: When you join, one choice is required: saving your network profile. Everything else is your choice, starts switched off, and can be withdrawn with one tap in Settings and my choices: appearing in Discover, training updates, parts and business offers on WhatsApp, using your pin for verification, being counted in your area total, showing your exact pin, saving your voice notes, smart correction, and helping to train our systems. We never ask for Aadhaar.
privacy.ustaadGrievanceBody: Complaints about network content, takedown requests and questions about your data go to our Grievance Officer, whose details are below. We acknowledge a complaint within 24 hours and resolve it within 7 days, and act faster in the urgent cases the law names, such as intimate images. If you are not satisfied with the answer, you can appeal to the Grievance Appellate Committee at gac.gov.in.

delivery.lead: How your order reaches you, what you pay and when.
delivery.pinBody: Enter your PIN code to see which parts we can deliver to you, the price, the delivery charge and how many days delivery takes.
delivery.pricesBody: Part prices include GST. The delivery charge is shown separately before you order, and delivery is free above the amount shown at checkout.
delivery.confirmBody: We check availability for your PIN. Once your order is confirmed, we tell you it is on its way. If we can't fulfil it, we let you know and you pay nothing.
delivery.codeBody: When your order is out for delivery you get a 4-digit delivery code. Give it to the delivery person only when the parts are in your hands.
delivery.payBody: Pay online with UPI, cards or net banking through Razorpay, or pay cash on delivery for orders up to the limit shown at checkout. Online payments are taken when you place the order; an order we cannot fulfil is refunded in full to the way you paid.
delivery.cancelBody: You can cancel until your order is packed. After that, parts can't be returned unless they are faulty, damaged or wrong; see our returns policy.

service.proposalBody: The workshop suggests a date, a time slot and an expected cost range. Your booking is confirmed only when you accept it.

service.cancelBody: You can cancel a booking free of charge until the workshop has your vehicle.
service.billBody: When the work is done you get a final bill with only the work you approved, and you pay that bill.
service.pickupBody: Vehicle pickup is available only where a workshop offers it, and is agreed with the workshop for your booking. We don't offer roadside help yet.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.lead: The rules for using MechDost to buy vehicle parts and book workshop services in Chhattisgarh. Plain words; by using MechDost you agree to them.
terms.whoBody: MechDost is a marketplace run by {company}, {address}. Parts are supplied by independent sellers and vehicle services are provided by verified workshops. MechDost arranges the order, payment and support.
terms.accountBody: You sign up with your mobile number (confirmed by a one-time code) and then sign in with your phone or email and a password. Keep your password to yourself and tell us at once if someone else may have used your account. Give true details: a wrong address or number can make an order fail. We may pause or close an account that is misused — for example fake cash-on-delivery orders, abuse of staff or partners, or fraud.
terms.ordersBody: Prices include GST and are shown for your PIN code; the delivery charge is shown before you order. An order is a request until MechDost confirms it: if we can't fulfil it we cancel it and refund anything you paid in full. When the order is out for delivery you get a delivery code: give it to the delivery person only after you have the parcel. Cash on delivery has an upper limit and may be unavailable for some orders or accounts.
terms.paymentsBody: Pay online through our payment partner (Razorpay) or in cash on delivery where offered. MechDost never asks for your card or UPI PIN. Refunds always go back to the way you paid, usually within 5–7 working days after we start them. An order that cannot be fulfilled is refunded in full.
terms.returnsTitle: No returns or exchanges — help when something is wrong
terms.returnsBody: We do not take returns or exchanges for a change of mind. If a part arrives faulty, damaged or wrong, raise a support request from your order within the time shown there, with photos; we check it and replace the part or refund you. Manufacturer warranties stay with the manufacturer, and we help you use them. Read the returns policy for details.
terms.servicesBody: For a service you ask a workshop for a time; the workshop proposes a slot and an expected cost, and you accept it. After it receives your vehicle it sends an itemised estimate: only the lines you approve are done and billed, and new work needs your new approval. You pay the workshop for the work it did; the workshop is responsible for the quality of its work, and we help if there is a problem. Read the workshop booking terms for details.
terms.coinsBody: Coins are a discount on later orders when the offer says so. They have no cash value, cannot be withdrawn, transferred or exchanged for money, and expire as shown in your account. Refunds never become Coins.
terms.messagesBody: We send updates about your orders, bookings and support requests by SMS, email, WhatsApp and in the app — they are part of the service. Offers and promotions are sent only if you agreed to them, and you can stop them at any time (for WhatsApp, reply STOP). Standard message charges of your mobile operator may apply.
terms.useBody: Do not misuse MechDost: no false orders or bookings, fake reviews, attempts to get around payment or security checks, copying the site with automated tools, or anything unlawful. Reviews must be about your own experience. We may remove content and limit accounts that break these rules.
terms.partnersBody: Shops and workshops that sell on MechDost also agree to the MechDost seller or workshop agreement, accepted in their portal. They are independent businesses; MechDost checks them before listing them but does not employ them.
terms.liabilityBody: We take care to show correct product details, prices and availability, and we fix mistakes when we find them. As far as the law allows, MechDost is not responsible for losses we could not reasonably foresee, or for how a part is fitted by someone else. Nothing in these terms takes away your rights under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.
terms.privacyBody: How we collect and use your data, and your choices, are explained in our privacy policy.
terms.changesBody: We may update these terms; the date below shows the latest version, and important changes are announced on the site before they apply. These terms follow Indian law, and the courts at Raipur, Chhattisgarh decide any dispute.
terms.contactBody: Raise a support request from your account, call us or contact support on WhatsApp. Our grievance officer acknowledges a complaint within 48 hours and resolves it within one month, as the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules require.
terms.help: Questions about these terms? Call us:
terms.updated: Last updated: 26 November 2026 (Ustaad Network rules added).
terms.ustaadBody: The Ustaad Network is only for people who repair vehicles. Join with your own details, keep one account, and never pretend to be someone else or to speak for MechDost. Levels, badges and Izzat are respect only: they have no money value and cannot be exchanged for MechDost Coins or cash. Advice from members is community advice, not a professional guarantee; check safety work on brakes, steering, fuel, airbags and high-voltage electric parts yourself.
terms.ustaadContentTitle: What you may post in the network
terms.ustaadContentBody: Post only your own work or content you have the right to share. Not allowed: abuse or hate; sexual content, and anything sexual involving children, which we report to the police; photos or videos of children working; customers' faces, number plates or phone numbers; illegal modifications such as silencer, odometer, emission or number plate tampering; fake or misleading claims; spam and selling; job scams, including asking anyone to pay for a job; and AI-made content that falsely shows a real person. Mark content made or edited with AI. What you post stays yours, and you allow MechDost to show it to network members.
terms.ustaadEnforcementBody: We may hold, remove or limit content, and warn, restrict or ban accounts that break these rules; we also remove content when a court or the government lawfully orders it. You are told why and can appeal through MechDost support. Employers who post jobs must state the pay, must hire only people aged 18 or older, and may never ask candidates for money; MechDost never charges anyone for a job. Report anyone who asks for money to 1930 or at cybercrime.gov.in.

communityRules.title: Ustaad Network Community Rules
communityRules.lead: The Ustaad Network is a place for mechanics to learn from each other. These rules keep it useful, safe and fair for everyone.
communityRules.whoBody: Only people who repair vehicles. Join with your own details, keep one account, and never pretend to be someone else or to speak for MechDost.
communityRules.respectBody: No abuse, bad language, threats, or hate about caste, religion, region, gender or anything else. Disagree about the work, never about the person.
communityRules.safetyBody: Advice here is community advice, not a professional guarantee. Say when work touches brakes, steering, fuel, airbags or high-voltage electric parts, and check safety work yourself.
communityRules.privacyBody: Never post a customer's face, number plate or phone number. Blur them before you post. Do not share anyone's private details.
communityRules.illegalBody: Do not post or ask for silencer, odometer, emission, DPF or catalytic converter tampering, number plate or chassis number changes, or kits that are not approved.
communityRules.childrenBody: No photos or videos of children working, and nothing that praises or asks for child labour. Anything sexual involving a child is removed at once, the account is frozen and we report it to the police.
communityRules.honestBody: No fake or misleading claims, spam or selling. Post only your own work or content you have the right to share. Mark content made or edited with AI; never use AI to falsely show a real person.
communityRules.jobsBody: Job posts must state the pay and hire only people aged 18 or older. Nobody may ask a candidate for money: MechDost never charges anyone for a job. Report anyone who asks for money to 1930 or at cybercrime.gov.in.
communityRules.reportBody: Use Report on any post, comment, answer, profile, job or message. Our team checks every report; intimate or fake pictures of a person are handled within hours.
communityRules.enforcementTitle: What happens if rules are broken
communityRules.enforcementBody: We may hold or remove content, warn, restrict or ban an account, and remove content when a court or the government lawfully orders it. You are told why in your language.
communityRules.appealBody: Disagree with a decision? Write to MechDost support; a different staff member decides your appeal. You can also write to our Grievance Officer, and if you are still not satisfied, to the Grievance Appellate Committee at gac.gov.in.
